wu-pass-move.title: Pass & Move Square

phases.label: Half hold a ball, half move free — everyone circulates inside the square.
Pass to a free player, then sprint away to find new space.
Build through: pass and follow, then a one-two.
Pass and move away from the ball as tempo rises.

script.value: Passing isn't the point here. The run they make after it is.
drill: Half the group with a ball each, half without, everyone moving inside the square.
Pass to a free player, then sprint to find new space.
Build through. Pass and follow, one two, then pass and move away.
Raise the tempo every two minutes until the touches are out of the feet.
script.dial: Too easy, call switch, the ball reaches the far half inside two passes. Too hard, walk it.

wu-pass-move.harder: Call "switch" — the ball must be moved to the opposite half of the square within two passes.
wu-pass-move.easier: Walk the movement pattern first with one ball between four.

captions.text: Half hold a ball, half move free — everyone circulates inside the square.

wu-rondo-circle.title: Rondo Circle Warm-Up

phases.label: Outside players keep the ball moving around the circle; one defender starts in the middle.
Ask for disguise — look one way, pass the other.
A misplaced pass or interception here swaps passer and defender.
Reset: the ball keeps circulating at the same width of feet.

script.value: This warms them up and sharpens the passing in the same go.
drill: A ring of cones, everyone spread around it, one defender in the middle.
Play across the circle or round it, whatever's on.
Give the ball away and you swap places with the defender.
Ask them to disguise it, look one way and pass the other.
script.dial: Too easy, one touch at match pace. Too hard, take the defender out and count passes.

wu-rondo-circle.harder: Call it one touch and keep the ball moving at match pace.
wu-rondo-circle.easier: Remove the defender and count consecutive passes instead.

captions.text: Outside players keep the ball moving around the circle; one defender starts in the middle.
Ask for disguise — look one way, pass the other.
A misplaced pass or interception here swaps passer and defender.
Reset: the ball keeps circulating at the same width of feet.

d-wide-2v1.title: Wide 2v1

phases.label: Two attackers enter the wide channel — one defender recovers across.
The defender closes the carrier: that is the cue. Punish the choice.
Overlap released to the byline — deliver first time, no recycling.
Arrive on the far side and finish. Rotate the defender every three.

script.value: Football's oldest exam. Make the defender choose, then punish the choice.
drill: Two attackers enter the channel against one recovering defender.
The carrier reads the defender. Drive inside if they hold wide, release the overlap if they close.
End every attack with a delivery or a strike, no recycling backwards. Rotate the defender every three.
script.dial: Too easy, a second defender recovers from behind. Too hard, the defender's passive until the first touch.

d-wide-2v1.harder: A second defender recovers from behind.
d-wide-2v1.easier: Defender is passive until the first touch inside the channel.

d-counter-2v1-waves.title: 2v1 Counter Waves

phases.label: Two attack one from the halfway cone — go straight at the defender.
Attack the defender directly; don't drift wide until they commit.
Committed — release the pass late, and the defender keeps recovering.
Finish within eight seconds or the defender has won the round.

script.value: Two against one should be a goal every time, and this shows them why it isn't.
drill: Two attackers break from halfway against one defender, one goal and a keeper.
Run straight at the defender. No sideways pass until they've committed to the ball.
Finish inside eight seconds, then rotate so everyone gets a turn defending it.
script.dial: Too easy, a second defender recovers from behind. Too hard, the defender can only block the shot.

d-counter-2v1-waves.harder: Add a second recovering defender who starts 8m behind.
d-counter-2v1-waves.easier: Defender starts passive and may only block the shot.

Finish within eight seconds or the defender has won the round.

d-1v1-arrival.title: 1v1 From a Pass

phases.label: The defender nearest goal serves the attacker in, then comes out to meet him.
First touch decides everything — away from the defender, into space.
Drive at the space you've created — now it is a live one v one.
Score in either small goal within eight seconds.

script.value: A first touch drill in disguise. Most one against ones are lost before the dribble starts.
drill: The defender nearest the goals passes the attacker in, then comes out to meet them.
That first touch decides it. Away from the defender, into space.
Score in either small goal inside eight seconds. Six attacks each, then swap.
script.dial: Too easy, the defender goes as the pass is struck. Too hard, hold them back two seconds.

d-1v1-arrival.harder: The defender sets off the moment the ball leaves his foot.
d-1v1-arrival.easier: Delay the defender by two seconds.

captions.text: The defender nearest goal serves the attacker in, then comes out to meet him.

d-dribble-gates-score.title: Dribble the Gates

phases.label: Ball each — score a point for every gate you dribble through.
The same gate cannot be used twice in a row, so scan for the next one.
Redirect at speed toward an unused gate.
Through the gate — personal best each round.

script.value: Scanning is the skill here, and the scoring makes them do it without being told.
drill: Ball each, gates spread about the area. A point for every gate you dribble through.
Never the same gate twice in a row.
Sixty second rounds, three of them, beat your own score each time.
Last round, add one defender without a ball.
script.dial: Too easy, only gates taken at speed count. Too hard, walk it and let any gate count.

d-dribble-gates-score.harder: Only gates entered at speed count — walking through scores nothing.
d-dribble-gates-score.easier: Walk it first and drop the repeat rule: any gate counts, as often as they like.

captions.text: Ball each — score a point for every gate you dribble through.
Same gate can't be used twice in a row, so scan for the next one.
Through the gate — beat your best each round.

d-finishing-first-goals.title: First Goals

phases.label: Two short lines, a ball each — first to ten goals wins.
Dribble through the cone gate, one big touch, then shoot.
Other line goes — collect your ball and rejoin the opposite line.

7.text: a 15x12m grid with two mini-goals and a cone gate in the middle

script.value: At this age the finishing habit you're building is simply wanting to shoot.
drill: Two short lines, ball each, a mini goal for each line.
Dribble through the gate, one big touch, then shoot.
Get your own ball back and join the other line. Count the goals out loud, first to ten.
script.dial: Too easy, weaker foot goals count double. Too hard, bring the gate closer.

d-finishing-first-goals.harder: A finish with the weaker foot counts double.
d-finishing-first-goals.easier: Move the gate closer so the shot comes sooner.

captions.text: Two short lines, a ball each — first to ten goals wins.
Dribble through the cone gate, one big touch, then shoot.
Other line goes — collect your ball and rejoin the opposite line.

d-rondo-4v2.title: 4v2 Rondo

phases.label: Four outside players ring the grid; two defenders chase in the middle.
Quick passes round the square drag the defenders side to side.
The gap opens between the two — thread it to split them and score.
Pressure wins it — the defender steps in and takes it.

script.value: Angles beat passes. Receivers always give the passer two options, never one.
drill: Four outside players keep the ball from two defenders inside the grid.
Splitting the two defenders with a pass scores a point. Ten passes without loss also scores.
The passer who loses it swaps with the longest serving defender.
script.dial: Too easy, outside players move one cone round after each pass. Too hard, walk it with unlimited touches.

d-rondo-4v2.harder: Outside players must move one cone clockwise after each pass.
d-rondo-4v2.easier: Walk it, unlimited touches, until ten passes come easily.

captions.text: Four outside players ring the grid; two defenders chase in the middle.
